about_the_game: Oh no! The galaxy’s stars have fallen out of their constellations and must be carefully shifted back to their rightful locations. Star Children like you are the only celestial bodies that have arms, so it's your responsibility to put the stars back in place! Solve 25 handcrafted puzzles and try not to scramble the stars even worse than they already are. Go WILD, Star Child! Earn your place in the night sky!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: 4 Core CPU (2.5+ GHz)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Vulkan Support Required)
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

Recommended:

short_description: Enjoy a circular twist on sokoban puzzles with over 25 handcrafted levels to solve. Help return fallen stars to the night sky as a ‘Star Child’ and try your best not to scramble the stars even worse than they already are.
